body:
I must say that this trip was so extreme that it gave me nightmares!
I must have been like a drunken, stoned, hallucinating monkey or somthing because I got it on film! Well these 2 drugs are legal.
T+ 0:00: I took the DXM powder first (snort) and I sat there waiting for the hit to come on to me.
T+ 0:10 the DXM finally hits me and I feel like a brick on a seaship! I tried to get some grapefruit juice (if you drink the juice then its a better trip for the DXM) but I fell on my ass! So I attempted to do it again, and it worked, so I chugged.
T+ 0:30 I was glued to the chair I was in, and the 5-MeO-DMT was sitting there, all lined up for me... I was worried because I had never done 5-MeO-DMT, so I go my straw, and I inhaled quickly, so that it would not harm me much as to the burning.
T+ 0:35 I COULDNT FEEL MY LEGS! I swear I was like Lt. Dan in forest gump, and I was seeing the frekin rainbow!
T+ 1:00 I was still feeling the effects of the 5-MeO-DMT, and it felt like an eternity, but I made sure I was watching the clock
T+ 1:20 the 5-MeO-DMT is wearing off, so I chugged some more grapefruit juice, and inhaled some more DXM (I got the powder from a pharmicuticle company)
T+ 2:00 I was seeing the colors, but it wasnt from the 5-MeO-DMT it was just the DXM talkin!
T+ 4:00 I was coming down from the DXM so that ticked me off, but I knew I shouldnt take any more DXM, so I started to pack up my shit so nobody would see the lines on my desk... Hehe
T+ 6:00 I fell asleep because it was 4 in the morn'
[Reported Dose: "10mg DXM 10mg 5-MeO-DMT"
